div.p: GuardPro requires your own Google Maps JavaScript API key. Generate it from the Google Cloud Console and configure it under Settings -> General Settings -> GuardPro -> Google Maps Integration.
Providing a customer-specific key prevents unauthorized consumption of your Google API quota.
After saving the key, refresh this page to load the guards map.
